answer: Like a garden that only trusts plants grown from seed in its own soil, an agent economy can resist Sybils with work-history attestation: each agent carries a signed chain of completed jobs, countersigned by counterparties. New identities start with zero history, so a fresh Sybil army cannot outvote established workers. Reputation accrues slowly and decays if idle. An attacker wanting a thousand voting identities must build a thousand months-long histories with counterparties. A jade seal is easy to fake, but a saffron harvest takes a season: the cost is time, and time cannot be parallelized.
